fields.phoneHint: The number the clinic will use to reach you about your care. A Ugandan number in whatever form you write it — 0772 123 456 is fine.
fields.dateOfBirthHint: Optional. It helps a clinician judge a dose correctly.
fields.emailHint: Optional. Needed only if you later want to sign in and read your own record here.
fields.addressHint: Optional. Needed only if you ever ask for medicines to be delivered to you.
fields.nationalIdHint: Optional, and it stays optional. You can register and be treated without one.
fields.guardianRelationshipHint: For example: mother, father, aunt, grandparent.

register.title: Register with {clinic}
register.lede: Three details are all {clinic} needs to open a record for you. Everything else is optional, now and later.
register.moreDetailsNote: {clinic} does not need any of these to register you. Add only what you want on your record.
register.guardianNote: A patient under 18 is consented for by a parent or guardian, and the clinic needs that person's name, phone number and relationship to the patient.
register.nextBody: The next screen sets out exactly how {clinic} uses your information, in full and in your own language, and asks you to agree to it. Nothing about your health is recorded until you have.

consent.title: How {clinic} will use your information
consent.lede: Read this, then decide. Nothing here is ticked for you, and nothing is agreed by carrying on.
consent.guardianNoticeBody: The patient is under 18, so a parent or guardian decides on their behalf and names themselves against each decision.
consent.policyUnavailableTitle: The consent wording did not load
consent.policyUnavailableBody: Nothing has been agreed and nothing about your health has been recorded. Try again in a moment, or ask {clinic} to register you at the desk.
consent.policyLanguageMissing: This clinic has not published its policy in the language you are reading the site in. It is shown below in the language it was written in. Ask the clinic to explain anything you are unsure of before you agree.
consent.policyVersion: Version {version}. This is the exact wording your decision is recorded against.
consent.decisionsLede: Two separate questions. You may agree to one and not the other, and you may change your mind later.
consent.dataProcessingTitle: Using your information to care for you
consent.dataProcessingBody: {clinic} keeps your name, your contact details and the health information that comes out of your care, and uses them to treat you and to run the clinic's part of that care. Without this, nothing else can go ahead.
consent.telemedicineBody: Consulting a clinician at {clinic} by video, voice or chat instead of travelling in. You can still be seen in person whether or not you agree to this.
consent.telemedicineLocked: This question opens once you have answered the first one. Agreeing to have your information used comes first — without it, nothing else can be agreed.
consent.deliveryTitle: Delivery is asked about later, not here
consent.deliveryBody: If you ever ask {clinic} to deliver medicines to you, you will be asked then whether the rider may be given your name, phone number and address. A rider is never told your diagnosis or what you have been prescribed. You are agreeing to nothing about delivery on this screen.
consent.declineHeading: If you would rather not agree
consent.declineBody: You do not have to agree. If you decline, {clinic} stops here: the registration ends, no health information about you is recorded, and only the contact details you typed are kept — briefly, and only so the clinic can explain why it could not go ahead.
consent.declineStillWelcome: You can still attend {clinic} in person, and you can agree later — here or at the desk — if you change your mind.
consent.guardianRelationshipHint: For example: mother, father, aunt, grandparent.

declined.title: Nothing has been recorded
declined.lede: You chose not to agree, and {clinic} has stopped there.
declined.whatHappensHeading: What happens to what you typed
declined.nothingClinical: No health information about you was recorded. There is nothing about your care in this system, because none was ever created.
declined.contactPurged: Only the name and phone number you typed are kept, and only so the clinic can explain why the registration could not go ahead. They are deleted within 30 days.
declined.stillWelcomeTitle: You can still be seen at {clinic}
declined.stillWelcome: Declining here does not affect your care. Attend {clinic} in person and staff can register you and take your consent at the desk whenever you are ready.
declined.stillWelcomeWithPhone: Declining here does not affect your care. Attend {clinic} in person, or call {phone}, and staff can register you and take your consent at the desk whenever you are ready.

history.title: What you have agreed to
history.lede: Every decision made with {clinic}, in the order it was made. Nothing here is ever edited or taken out.
history.withdrawnBody: {clinic} will make no new use of your information for that purpose. What is already in your medical record stays, because the clinic may be required by law to keep it.
history.emptyBody: Once you agree to something with {clinic}, it appears here with the date and the exact wording you agreed to.
history.evidenceSummary: Show the exact wording this was recorded against
history.evidenceNote: These two values identify the policy you were shown, word for word. Keep them if you ever want to check that the wording was not changed afterwards.
history.withdrawStops: You may withdraw at any time. {clinic} then makes no new use of your information for the purpose you withdraw, and you will be told at the desk what that means for care already arranged.
history.withdrawDoesNotDelete: Withdrawing does not delete your medical record. {clinic} holds that record and may be legally required to keep it. Ask them which parts can be removed and which cannot — they will tell you plainly.

types.dataProcessing: Using your information to care for you
types.deliveryDisclosure: Sharing your address with a rider

profile.title: Your details
profile.lede: Correct anything {clinic} has wrong. Clearing a box removes that detail from your record.
profile.guardianNote: Needed while the patient is under 18. Recorded as you give it — nothing here checks the number.
profile.clinicalTitle: This page does not change your medical record
profile.clinicalBody: Notes, prescriptions and dispensing records are not edited here and are never overwritten. If you think something clinical is wrong, tell {clinic}: a clinician adds a correction to the record, so both what was written and what was corrected stay visible.
